**Elastic net & correlated predictors.** Its penalty mixes ℓ₂ (ridge) and ℓ₁ (lasso) parts; ridge shrinks correlated coefficients toward each other so they "borrow strength," and the elastic net effectively averages highly correlated predictors and enters the average, removing the degeneracy where lasso picks one and ignores the rest 【file-01a1bbc7-d272-7851-a045-bc953cc33840】.

**glmnet path fitting.** Solutions are computed over a decreasing grid of λ values from λ_max = maxⱼ|xⱼᵀy| down to λ_min = ελ_max (e.g., ε = 0.001, K = 100 log-spaced values), using cyclical coordinate descent with warm starts from the previous λ and active-set iterations 【file-01a1bbc7-d272-7851-a045-bc953cc33840】.

**Strong rules need a KKT check.** Strong rules discard predictors via |xⱼᵀr| < 2λ − λ₀, but they are "not foolproof" and can drop nonzero coefficients, unlike SAFE rules; so KKT conditions (xⱼᵀ(y − Xβ̂) = λ·sⱼ) are checked afterward, and violations force refitting 【file-01a1bbc7-d28a-7c10-af1e-241d70fe1a9d】.
